summary.zh: 本次更新修复了技能徽章在历史会话中丢失的问题，并统一了提供商目录与运行时模型状态，使设置更可靠。
summary.en: This release fixes skill badges disappearing from history and unifies provider catalog with runtime model state for more reliable settings.

title.zh: 修复技能徽章在历史与重试中丢失
title.en: Fix skill badges lost in history and retries

summary.zh: 技能徽章现在会在历史会话、重试和分支会话中正确保留。
summary.en: Skill badges now persist correctly across history, retries, and forked sessions.

details.zh: 显示记录携带技能列表，通过结构化写入保护。
details.en: Display records carry skill list through structured write guard.

details.zh: 历史投影和重试/恢复路径均恢复技能。
details.en: History projection and retry/restore path restore skills.

details.zh: 分支会话复制显示记录，子会话通过修复后的投影读取。
details.en: Forking copies display record, child sessions read via fixed projection.

sources.title: fix(session): persist skill badges across history and retries

title.zh: 统一提供商目录与运行时模型状态
title.en: Unify provider catalog and runtime model state

summary.zh: 设置窗口现在从持久化的提供商目录和页面草稿派生状态，删除操作与运行时模型刷新更可靠。
summary.en: Settings window now derives state from persisted provider catalog and page drafts; deletion and model refresh are more reliable.

details.zh: 左侧边栏不再依赖本地选择历史，删除提供商时收敛自权威状态。
details.en: Left rail no longer depends on local selection history; deleting provider converges from authoritative state.

details.zh: 所有辅助选择器共享运行时模型目录，主窗口通过既有 IPC 和事件触发刷新。
details.en: All auxiliary selectors share runtime model directory; main window re-broadcasts changes over IPC and events.

details.zh: 异步凭据写入后等待再刷新模型，并序列化每次刷新，防止旧快照覆盖新值。
details.en: Wait for async credential writes before refreshing; serialize refreshes to prevent stale snapshots overwriting.

details.zh: 提供商/模型写入路径会拒绝 HTTP 2xx 但包含 JSON 错误的情况，避免失败被当作成功。
details.en: Write paths reject HTTP 2xx with JSON errors so failures are never treated as success.

sources.title: fix(settings): unify provider catalog and runtime model state

title.zh: 调整 AtomGit 上传超时设置

summary.zh: 发布流程对慢速 AtomGit 上传的容忍度已调整，但随后又回滚了该改动。
summary.en: Release process tolerance for slow AtomGit uploads was adjusted and then reverted.

details.zh: 曾尝试允许较慢的 AtomGit 上传，但该改动被回滚。
details.en: Attempted to allow slower AtomGit uploads, but the change was reverted.

details.zh: 当前版本维持原有超时行为。
details.en: Current version retains original timeout behavior.

summary.zh: 产品版本已提升至 0.1.25，并记录了修复与验证过程。
summary.en: Product version advanced to 0.1.25 with documented fix and verification phases.

details.zh: 记录了提供商/模型状态漂移修复、真实 UI 点击验证和技能徽章持久化工作。
details.en: Documented provider/model state-drift fixes, real-UI click verification, and skill badge persistence.

details.zh: 版本号严格大于历史 v0.1.24。
details.en: Version is strictly greater than historical v0.1.24.

sources.title: chore(release): record v0.1.25 prep and advance version to 0.1.25 (generation 3)
